The existence of this '''sentient life form''' was hidden by [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]], during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], at that life form's request. When it's existence was eventually discovered, Rorworr earned an official reprimand from his superiors.
